reviews.title: read before downloading
reviews.text: Literally deleted all my flashcards as it logged me out of my account. I tried logging back in and it would not work. I tried emailing etc but would not help:(((. Also price  for premium has gone from £5 a month to £17. It is a good app for studying and memorising, but definitely has its flaws!

reviews.title: Decks disappear
reviews.text: Hi there, my decks have disappeared and this isn’t the first time it has happened. Disappointing.

reviews.title: Not forgetting May 2025
reviews.text: App crashed and was unusable for the whole exam season. No biggie though, it’s not like I kept ALL my FLASHCARDS on the FLASHCARDS app.

reviews.title: Good app, but annoying review nag screen
reviews.text:
I am leaving a review to hopefully remove the annoying nag screen encouraging me to do so. Minus one star for that.

I hate that the in-app review screen insists on generating AI slop for a draft review before it will let me edit it. Minus one star for this.

Despite those annoyances I like the app. I’m learning Cantonese and while I couldn’t find many suitable decks it’s easy enough to create my own.

Edit: Minus one more star for continuing to pester me for review after I left one.

Edit May 2026: Wow, new low for this app. This morning it acted as if had just installed it, and when I finally managed to delete the upsell dialogue it had deleted my carefully crafted stacks of cards. I’m gobsmacked. Will not trust again.

reviews.title: The worst app to use
reviews.text: I have used this app for over 2 years but recently whenever I make a dekc of flahscards they get deleted. I'm not sure if it's an issue with the app but it is impossible to get them back afterwards. Trust me use ANKI or Quizlet - not Noji. Worst app I've ever used

reviews.title: Some debug code thing
reviews.text: It keeps asking me for a debug code and won’t let me sighn in if a developer sees this please fix it as it’s pathetic to have a app that I can’t even use

reviews.title: Scammers !!! Beware
reviews.text: Took money from my paypal 2-3years after i downloaded this app for no reason through random subscription set up on payday for today. Be careful people

reviews.title: DO NOT USE
reviews.text: If i could give this app 0 stars, I would. I spent ages making a deck of flash cards now i have just opened the app to find out they have reset my account and all my flash cards have gone and are unrecoverable. Hours of my life I will never get back. I do not rate this app one bit, don’t waste your time. Terrible app.

reviews.title: Do not use
reviews.text: If you try making flashcards with an Apple Pencil it will just make black screen instead meaning I have lost all of my flashcards.

reviews.title: broken apple pencil
reviews.text: the new update breaks canvas notes because it sets the background to black, while, when you’re making the canvas card with the apple pencil, the background is white - all my drawn cards are invisible…

reviews.title: Good app but makes you pay
reviews.text: Why should you have to pay for revision, I’m just trying to pass my GCSE’s and this app makes you pay if I want to revise more than 50 cards a day. I get they need to make profit but they already get money from downloads and users anyway. Just seems stupid to make teens pay for something that is crucial,especially when most teens do not have a job to pay for these things

reviews.title: It’s not working at the moment , with the images
reviews.text: I honestly was loving it initially  because it was easy to use and I loved how you could draw on flashcards. However recently I’ve been drawing on the flashcards . Then saying I’ve done drawing and when I’ve gone to view the image it’s all black with some coulored elements . It’s not like I can now edit it ; it would let me edit it . Please can you fix this because I’ve really been loving the app so far .

reviews.title: Wiped my flashcards randomly
reviews.text: When opening the app my deck (100+ cards) are all gone. I did not delete them.

reviews.title: would not recommend, unreliable
reviews.text: I’ve been using this app for my a levels and paid for premium, however a large number of my cards disappeared with no explanation just before my exams. The customer support offered no assistance - despite repeated requests. This platform is unreliable and I will not be using it again.

reviews.title: Not good!
reviews.text: Was poorly made as you can only review a certain number of flashcards before you have to pay.I only found out about the fact you have a limit after I had made over 500 flashcards so was super disappointed!

reviews.title: Annoying
reviews.text: I’m going to keep leaving poor reviews until the app stops reminding me to leave a review.
